description: This file declares the interface for health monitoring of a filesystem monitor daemon. It includes function prototypes for initializing, cleaning up, running, and stopping the health check thread, with backend-specific implementations guarded by macros.

methods.name: fsm_health__ctor
methods.description: Initializes platform-specific data for the fsmonitor health thread before it starts.

methods.name: fsm_health__dtor
methods.description: Cleans up platform-specific data after the health thread has finished.

methods.name: fsm_health__loop
methods.description: Runs the main event loop to monitor the daemon's health status.

methods.name: fsm_health__stop_async
methods.description: Requests gracefully stopping the health thread without waiting for it to finish.
